function.name: execute_bash

content:
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mbedtls && grep -R "server10.crt\|server.*crt\|nocopy" -n tests/data_files tests/suites | head -50 && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('library/x509_crt.c')
s=p.read_text()
old='''    if( ( ret = mbedtls_asn1_get_tag( &p, end, &len,
            MBEDTLS_ASN1_CONSTRUCTED | MBEDTLS_ASN1_SEQUENCE ) ) != 0 )
    {
        mbedtls_x509_crt_free( crt );
        return( MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_INVALID_FORMAT );
    }
'''
new='''    if( ( ret = mbedtls_asn1_get_tag( &p, end, &len,
            MBEDTLS_ASN1_CONSTRUCTED | MBEDTLS_ASN1_SEQUENCE ) ) != 0 )
    {
        if( make_copy != 0 )
            mbedtls_x509_crt_free( crt );
        return( MBEDTLS_ERR_X509_INVALID_FORMAT );
    }
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('old not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
